image_brief: Jason Oppenheim sells Bentley for Tesla Model Y after Tesla FSD self-driving blows his mind mid-drive

slides.headline: TESLA FSD JUST MADE EVERY HUMAN DRIVER THE DANGEROUS ONE

caption:
Jason Oppenheim, founder of the Oppenheim Group with $5B+ in real estate sales, sold his Bentley for a Tesla Model Y after Tesla FSD stunned him so hard mid-drive that he called his brother and talked until his brother bought a Tesla before they even hung up. He says FSD is 8x safer than the average human driver, and he's now ordering 10 more Teslas for his employees. When status buyers ditch Bentleys because software beats the badge, luxury carmakers have a problem no amount of leather can fix.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this kind of automation could do for yours.

Sources: Sawyer Merritt on X, Oct 3 2026

#Tesla #FSD #SelfDriving #Technology #AI
pinned_comment: If Tesla FSD is actually 8x safer than a human driver, you're now statistically choosing the more dangerous option every time you get behind the wheel. Would you let it drive you?
